pl-l2d24c2-d1e108.summary: Asks what the help given at creation was, by which man could remain if he willed.

pl-l2d24c2-d1e111.summary: Answers: freedom of choice free of every stain and corruption, rectitude of will, and the soundness and vigor of all the soul's natural powers.
claims: The help was free choice, upright will, and sound powers.

pl-l2d24c2.summary: Asks what the help given at creation was: freedom of choice untouched by any stain or corruption, rectitude of will, and the integrity and vigor of all the soul's natural powers.
claims: The help given at creation was uncorrupted free choice, rectitude of will, and integrity of the soul's powers.
